title: PaSta: Noisy Node Classification with Partial Label Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.25365v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Noisy node classification problem is a fundamental yet challenging task for real-world graph-related web services, where node labels are often corrupted or unreliable due to weak supervision or automatic annotation. However, existing methods typically train models based on one-hot labels, which not only makes models susceptible to overfitting on noisy labels, but also leads to error accumulation after pseudo-label-guided enhancement. In this paper, we propose a novel Partial label-based Self-training framework (PaSta for short) that leverages partial label learning technique to overcome the limitations of existing methods. Specifically, PaSta first trains multiple annotators to comprehensively capture the class distribution of nodes and aggregates their predictions to construct high-quality partial labels. translated_title: PaSta：基于部分标签学习的噪声节点分类
translated_abstract: 噪声节点分类问题是现实图相关网络服务中一个基础且具有挑战性的任务，其中节点标签常因弱监督或自动标注而受到污染或不可靠。然而，现有方法通常基于单热标签训练模型，这不仅使模型容易过拟合噪声标签，还会在伪标签引导增强后导致错误累积。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于部分标签的自训练框架（简称PaSta），利用部分标签学习技术来克服现有方法的局限性。具体来说，PaSta首先训练多个标注器全面捕获节点的类别分布，并聚合它们的预测以构建高质量的部分标签。随后，我们设计了一个基于部分标签的分类模型，并配备两个精心设计的损失函数，以指导模型学习。
tldr: 本文提出PaSta框架，通过多标注器聚合生成部分标签并设计定制损失函数，有效解决了噪声节点分类中的过拟合和错误累积问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the PaSta framework, which generates partial labels by aggregating multiple annotators and designs tailored loss functions to effectively address overfitting and error accumulation in noisy node classification.
